title: Prednisolone in the Treatment of Withdrawal Headache in Probable Medication Overuse Headache
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether prednisolone is more effective than placebo in the first six days after initiation of medication withdrawal therapy for a medication overuse headache. Another purpose is to study whether patients followed by a neurologist 1 year after withdrawal do better than patients followed by a general practitioner.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Chronic daily headache and medication overuse fulfilling International Headache Society (IHS)-II criteria

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy
* Age under 18 and over 70 years
* Major mental disorders
